critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes_data.py mark_converted (line 335-341) selects most-recent unconverted claim within last 7 days sorted by (qr_downloaded desc, date desc). If a partner redeems a code that was clicked >7 days ago, no claim gets flagged converted but the 'venda' WS event still fires with claim_id=None. Consider widening the lookback or falling back to campaign-only match.

backend/routes_data.py public_qr_downloaded (line 322-332) does NOT require authentication and accepts any body.claim_id — an attacker can spam qr_downloaded=true for any claim they can enumerate (ids are cl-<10hex>). Consider rate-limiting or requiring the ip+ua key of the claim.

backend/routes_data.py public_coupon (line 300-309) still stores full IP in 'key' (used only server-side) but exposes 'cliente': 'Cliente #<last-octet-or-4>' — mild PII leak for /24 blocks; acceptable but flag it.

backend/routes_data.py _claim_state considers a claim 'Abandonou' after 48h regardless of qr_downloaded — a click with QR downloaded 60h ago would flip from 'QR sem scan' to 'Abandonou'. Intentional? UI badges the same as no-download.
backend/routes_data.py clicks_analysis has to_list(500) — hard cap may silently drop older rows for 30d period once traffic grows.

backend/realtime.py emit() swallows RuntimeError silently when no running loop — if server ever calls emit from a sync context (e.g., background task) events are dropped without logging. Add a logger.warning.
seed_data_creation: Backend test created ~4 fresh CLUB-10 coupon_claims (unique UAs) and 2 redemptions (idempotency=iter20-<hex>, iter20ws-<hex>, amounts 45 and 30). Frontend test created 2 more claims and 1 redemption (idempotency=iter20ui-<hex>, amount 20). Explicit IDs captured in stdout: claim_id=cl-3c23a4a005 redemption_idem=iter20ui-83392c60ec (UI last run), plus SEED_CREATED / WS_SEED lines in pytest -s output.
context_for_next_testing_agent: WS event key is 'tipo' (NOT 'type'/'event'). Realtime.py emit() serializes as {tipo, ts, ...payload}. novo_clique carries {dados:{id,coupon,campaign,influencer,partner,origem,cliente,date,qr_downloaded,converted,valor}}; qr_baixado carries {claim_id,cupom,at}; venda carries {valor,comissao,cupom,claim_id,at}. To force new coupon_claims past the 12h ip+ua dedupe use requests.get / page.context.request.get with a UNIQUE User-Agent header. The admin funnel KPI values use useCountUp animation — wait ~2s after event for Math.round(v) to settle. AbandonAnalysis default period is '7d'; on 'hoje' rows may be 0 if no clicks today. Redemption body uses 'code' + 'idempotency_key' (NOT 'cupom'). websockets.sync.client works fine against wss:// preview URL with ?token= query param.
rca of the issue: No production bugs found. Notable code smells (unauthenticated qr-downloaded endpoint; 48h 'Abandonou' overriding QR downloaded state; hard 500-row analysis cap) flagged for main agent review.
